context.description: The summary is written even when a turn is in flight or the run was cancelled

evidence.trustReason: Fresh review after cfc1bb0948 (owner ruling 10). The commit changes only four pollWithTimeout bounds (judge hit 240 s, root-turn hit 120 s, runFinal 240 s, closed 240 s) and three test timeouts (900 s); every expect, the Given, the three When paths and the 1 s / 0.5 s no-summary windows are unchanged. Each bound waits for a positive progress signal or ends a hang; none bounds a negative check, so a larger bound cannot turn a failure into a pass (a dropped summary still fails summaryLog and the one-summary count; a hang still fails). Given: the real SessionPrompt/TaskHarness/BackgroundJob wiring resumes a stored release-notes slice with S4's judge held; the user's question reaches the scripted model with its reply held, and SessionStatus is busy. When: (a) the judge verdict ends the run (runFinal: free lease plus scenario.verified; ended() asserts the folded machine is final); (b) SessionPrompt.cancel aborts the root session (one run.cancelled, no S4 verdict stored); (c) BackgroundJob.cancel cancels the run (run.cancelled, ended). Then: in (a) and (c) no summary and no summary failure log while the root turn is held, and in (a) the run is still running; after the turn ends (or is aborted in b) the run closes and exactly one assistant summary starting with the outcome line exists, parented on the run header, last in the transcript, after the question with only assistant messages between. prompt.say structurally waits through ensureRunning. And: a later prompt returns the scripted LATER answer, the model server records the LATER hit, and the summary count stays 1. Rerun at load 43-66: 3 pass, 0 fail, 50 expect() calls, 73.67 s.
